input.prompt:
Create ONE complete 30-second 9:16 cinematic film at 1080p, generated continuously as a single deliverable. Silent picture. A premium, photoreal sky world connects a search interface, an AI chat answer, its purple SKY citation, an imposing full-size SKY aircraft and a long clean animated sky ending. Maintain spatial continuity, physical scale and momentum throughout.

REFERENCE ROLES AND PRIORITY
@Image1 and @Image2 are the empty and completed search field, with the intended readable lateral perspective. @Image3 is the three-result state. @Image4 is the user chat turn alone. @Image5 is the complete assistant response. @Image6 shows its attached citation becoming luminous. These are sequential UI states, never multiple duplicated interfaces; preserve their exact Spanish text and hierarchy. They provide the sky palette, with one consistent sun and cloud world throughout, but animate the atmosphere naturally.
@Image7, @Image8, @Image9 and @Image10 are four isolated views of ONE identical SKY Airbus A320neo. They govern aircraft geometry, livery, winglets, cockpit, engines and proportions only. Their transparent backgrounds are not a setting. Render photographic painted metal and real glass, not a studio product render or plastic model.
@Video1 is a 5-second extract of the successful aircraft approach, close lateral pass and rear-quarter departure. It guides only the FLIGHT CAMERA PATH and moving aircraft during the middle of the new film. It is not the opening, not a full-film timing guide and must not be looped. Retain the imposing close pass and same-side rear-quarter tracking. Let the new entrance flow into this motion naturally, with ONE solid airplane, no dissolve between planes or positional reset.

CAMERA GRAMMAR ACROSS THE FILM
Three recurring camera behaviors, not three compulsory cuts: B is a lateral 28–35mm-equivalent traveling view, clear perspective and parallax, used for search and close flight pass. C is an elevated oblique tracking view that follows the results downward, follows the growing answer toward its citation, and follows the departing plane from behind and beside. A is a restrained 45–55mm-equivalent hero/reading view, used to stabilize reading, accompany the approaching plane and continue into the sky plate. Keep the horizon level and the same side of the flight axis. The UI remains fully framed and legible during camera movement. Smooth spatial transitions, never rotating whole text like a flat slideshow. Energetic arrivals, stable readable holds, connected exits.

ORDER AND TIMING — ALL TIMES REFER TO THE NEW 30-SECOND OUTPUT
0.00–1.80: Begin with the empty field @Image1 floating in immense photographic sunset clouds. Type exactly “¿A dónde viajar en Sudamérica?” to reach @Image2 by 1.65. Camera B slides laterally with visible oblique depth throughout typing; do not flatten to frontal immediately. The whole field stays inside the frame. At 1.80 show a small decisive submit pulse and cursor disappearance, without inventing labels or buttons.
1.80–3.80: Three search results from @Image3 arrive in order with a short tactile stagger. C travels down slightly through their layers; keep each readable and the entire stack comfortably framed. Names and copy as supplied: Balneário Camboriú, Mendoza, Puerto Fuy. Give this stage its own readable beat.
3.80–4.40: Results retract and the SAME query becomes the user chat bubble @Image4. Remove magnifier and search controls. Show the user turn alone briefly before the assistant begins. Never return to search results.
4.40–6.20: Below the user turn, a modern assistant panel expands downward as meaningful groups of words are revealed. C follows the growing lower edge with restrained parallax, settling toward A. Exact response from @Image5: “Tres ideas: Camboriú, por sus playas; Mendoza, por sus bodegas; y Puerto Fuy, por sus lagos y volcanes.” The attached purple “SKY Airline” citation is inside this response, below the answer. It is a source citation, not a fourth search result or unrelated floating button.
6.20–8.40: Hold the full readable answer. The camera makes a slow purposeful downward reframe toward the citation without moving the text itself. Preserve reading time and a modern spatial feel; no dead freeze.
8.40–10.00: The purple citation compresses slightly on activation. A lime edge and purple luminous core intensify. C accelerates smoothly into the citation; surrounding UI leaves the frame through camera travel. The glyphs leave the view before the aircraft appears. The light opens directly into the SAME golden sky volume, revealing the full-size aircraft already traveling toward and past the camera. Keep continuous optical expansion, cloud parallax and forward velocity through the reveal. No white-out followed by a distant static airplane, no braking or new establishing shot, no airplane miniaturized inside giant letters.
10.00–13.25: Carry that same airplane into the approach and close pass of @Video1. A accompanies a dynamic frontal three-quarter approach, scale growing continuously. B takes the imposing close lateral fuselage/wing pass around 12.7–13.3, using the physical pass to carry the viewpoint change. Photographic airline scale, detailed engines, natural reflections and aerodynamic motion. Camera remains outside the airframe.
13.25–15.75: C tracks the SAME aircraft from behind and beside like real air-to-air drone footage. It keeps traveling forward and recedes naturally toward the upper-right depth, clearing the central reading region by 15.75. The camera does not overtake it. No duplicate airplane, direction reversal, jump backward, dissolve, morph or artificial fade-out. No smoke or vapor emitted from wings.
15.75–25.75: Continue through the SAME animated sky left by the departure, as a premium clean background plate. A slow controlled forward drift and subtle lateral cloud parallax sustain life and scale. Keep the central 80% width and vertical band 27%–57% calm, evenly readable and in blue midtones for later white graphics. Put the strongest sun and cloud highlights below that region. No aircraft crossing the central area, no new objects, no cards or empty panels. Do not freeze or loop the clouds. Maintain natural atmospheric continuity, sun direction and horizon; no sudden scene resets. This entire interval contains ZERO text, numbers, plus signs, logos or graphics; they will be composited separately. Do not infer slogans or titles from the brand.
25.75–26.00: Resolve the sky into a clean deep blue field matching #022A4E through a smooth luminous wash, completed at 26.00. It fills the entire frame; no shape or panel edges.
26.00–27.50: Hold the clean deep blue field #022A4E, camera locked, absolutely no text, logos, URL bubble or symbols.
27.50–28.50: Change only the full-frame background smoothly from blue to SKY purple #701C74.
28.50–30.00: Hold the clean purple field, without fade to black or return to sky. The full closing remains empty for exact graphics added later.

PHOTOGRAPHIC QUALITY AND EXCLUSIONS
Real clouds with volume, depth, wind and warm sunlight; deep blue upper sky. One physical aircraft identity across all angles, full airline scale, detailed painted aluminum, glass and engines. No toy/plastic appearance, deformed wings, mirrored livery, wing smoke or invented contrails. No captions, extra copy or narrator. Audio is disabled. The only visible text belongs to the supplied search/chat UI before 10 seconds and the aircraft's authentic livery while in flight. All post-flight title and closing graphics are deliberately absent. Deliver the complete thirty-second film in one generation.
